reports.notes: The COVER is the county's legacy form but its printed title is the shorter '2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' (no '& LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD'), and the side rail reads 'COUNTY CANDIDATES'. That summary page is typed, not handwritten (high confidence on every figure). 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period' prints as a bare '$  -' (Excel accounting-format zero); transcribed verbatim as '-' rather than as 0 or as blank. Neither amendment box is marked, so is_amendment is left empty. The Office Seeking field reads simply 'Treasurer' (no 'County' prefix); phone and fax fields were left blank by the filer.
